Install dropbox on Omarchy

Dropbox is a cloud storage and file-sharing service that syncs your files, photos, and documents across devices and lets you share or collaborate on them with others. It previews over 175 file types in the browser or app, supports large file transfers up to 250GB, and now layers in AI-assisted search and organization features alongside its core sync-and-share functionality.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add dropbox
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 274.4.4905-1:
    pacman -Qi dropbox

Open and use dropbox

dropbox is a desktop app. Press Super + Space to open the launcher and search for it. If it does not show up by name, list the desktop entries the package installed:

pacman -Ql dropbox | grep applications

dropbox requirements and compatibility

  • A Dropbox account
  • Network access to sync files

Frequently asked questions

How do I install dropbox on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add dropbox. The download is 89.3 MB and it takes 159.5 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is dropbox free?

Basic tier is free with 2GB; Plus is $9.99/mo for 2TB; Standard $15/user/mo, Advanced $24/user/mo for teams, Enterprise is custom. The package is licensed custom:Dropbox.

How do I uninstall dropbox?

Run omarchy pkg drop dropbox. It removes the package from your system.

What does dropbox depend on?

The package declares 9 dependencies: libsm, libxslt, libxmu, libxdamage, libxrender, libxxf86vm, libxcomposite, fontconfig, dbus. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is dropbox a desktop app?

Yes. Open the launcher with Super + Space and search for dropbox.

Is dropbox in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as dropbox (version 274.4.4905-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Dropbox makes it. Project site: https://www.dropbox.com.
